episodes.synopsis: When Superbook falls onto a computer keyboard, Ruffles, a dog, is accidentally transported back into the ancient time of Abram, the patriarch.
episodes.title: Where, Oh Where...

episodes.synopsis: The time-travelers come across the city of Sodom, which is about to be destroyed because of its wickedness.
episodes.title: Hot Dog

episodes.synopsis: The children again come across Abraham, Sarah, and a newly arrived son, named Isaac. Later, the children witness Abraham's nearly attempted sacrifice of Isaac.
episodes.title: The Test of Faith and Obedience

episodes.synopsis: The children travel to the Mesopotamian city of Nahor, where they witness a group of people seeking a suitable wife for Abraham's son, Isaac.
episodes.title: Love at First Sight

episodes.synopsis: The children witness the story of Jacob and his beloved son, Joseph, and how Joseph's jealous brothers sell Joseph into slavery in Egypt.
episodes.title: Father's Pet

episodes.synopsis: The children travel to Pharaoh's palace in ancient Egypt where they see Joseph thrown into prison unjustly, only to later be released and given a high position of honor as governor.
episodes.title: All About Dreams

episodes.synopsis: The time-travelers witness how Joseph, governor of Egypt, successfully deals with famine in Egypt. Also, they witness how Joseph will deal with his lost brothers who came to Egypt for grain.
episodes.title: The Hostage

episodes.synopsis: The children experience how Joseph tests his brothers to determine whether they are repentant about selling Joseph into slavery years earlier.
episodes.title: The Family Reunion

episodes.synopsis: The children witness how Egypt no longer welcomes the children of Israel, and how the Israelites are now enslaved and treated brutally. A young man names Moses is coming forth to change things.
episodes.title: A Gift From Heaven

episodes.synopsis: The children witness Moses at the burning bush and Moses' demands to Pharaoh to let the Israelites out of bondage and out of Egypt.
episodes.title: The Burning Bush

episodes.synopsis: The time-travelers experience the many plagues sent upon Egypt to punish Pharaoh for not releasing the enslaved Israelites.
episodes.title: No More Plagues

episodes.synopsis: The children witness how the Red Sea parted to provide the Israelites an escape from the Egyptians, and how the closing of the parted sea downs the Egyptian army.
episodes.title: So You Want To Go Back To Egypt!

episodes.synopsis: The children experience a complaining group of Israelites, who are punished with poisonous snakes.  But finally after 40 years, Israel begins to rally round Joshua, their new leaders.
episodes.title: Snakes and a Donkey

episodes.synopsis: The time-travelers witness how Othniel conquers the Canaanite city of Debir because Caleb promised a daughter as a reward.
episodes.title: Worth Fighting For

episodes.synopsis: The children witness Ehud's overthrow of King Eglon of Moab. A rebellion has erupted and the Israelites are fighting for their freedom
episodes.title: The Good Left Arm

episodes.synopsis: In this action-filled episode, the Israelites defeat an invading Canaanite army who gets trapped in the mud.
episodes.title: Stick in the Mud

episodes.synopsis: The time-travelers are in ancient Israel when Israel is in a state of war, led by a great but rash general names Jephthah.
episodes.title: That's a Promise

episodes.synopsis: The children witness the story of Eli and Samuel in the city of Shiloh.
episodes.title: Just Rewards

episodes.synopsis: The time-travelers nearly become involved in a war, and Israel demands that a king be established.
episodes.title: A Wonderful Gift

episodes.synopsis: The time-travelers meet a young boy named David, who skillfully uses musical instruments and weapons.
episodes.title: The Mighty Little Shepherd

episodes.synopsis: The children witness the battle between David and Goliath, where the future of Israel as a nation rests upon the outcome.
episodes.title: The Bigger They Come

episodes.synopsis: The children witness Saul's jealousy and hatred for David. Saul is determined to kill David, so David flees.
episodes.title: Faithful and True

episodes.synopsis: David, who has an opportunity to take Saul's life, spares Saul. Finally, David is proclaimed King of Israel after Saul dies in battle.
episodes.title: David the King

episodes.synopsis: The children experience the dedication of the temple and King Solomon's great wisdom.
episodes.title: In All His Glory

episodes.synopsis: The children almost experience death when Queen Athaliah decides to kill her "rivals" for the throne, but eventually, the Queen is put to death and a just ruler is installed.
episodes.title: The Wicked Queen

episodes.synopsis: The children find themselves in a country about to be invaded by the might Assyrian army. However, God intervenes and destroys the Assyrians. The children then return to the 20th Century.
episodes.title: A Matter Of Time
